capabilities: Start and stop a timer on the active note, tagged with its client and project properties
Show unbilled hours and amounts per client at a configurable rate
Generate sequentially numbered Markdown invoices from unbilled time for a period
Export invoices as locally generated PDFs with pagination
Void issued invoices and record which hours each invoice billed to avoid double billing
extras: Freemium: time tracking, status bar timer, unbilled totals and invoice preview are free; writing invoice files, PDF export and billing allocation require a $29 one-time key verified offline. Free preview shows the invoice before purchase. Data is stored locally in data.json; PDF export is limited to Latin-1 characters and refuses unsupported scripts while still writing the Markdown invoice.
motivation: The hours are already in your vault. They just never become an invoice.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn time spent working in notes into per-client billable records and invoices without reconstructing hours from memory or file timestamps.

relations.evidence: the licensing approach, settings-tab patterns, build/test setup and project layout are adapted from the Vault Spotlight plugin
it builds invoices from #billable lines you have already typed, where this plugin clocks the time itself

requires.name: license key ($29 one-time) for invoice writing, PDF export and billing periods

summary: Time tracker that logs billable hours against notes, totals unbilled time per client, and generates numbered Markdown and PDF invoices.
